final: WITH exam_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as exam_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), total_info AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total_exams, COUNT(*) as total_patients FROM exam_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT ec.ID, ec.exam_count, CAST(ec.exam_count AS FLOAT) / ti.total_exams as share, CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / ti.total_patients as avg_share, CAST(ec.exam_count AS FLOAT) / ti.total_exams - CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / ti.total_patients as margin_above_avg FROM exam_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_info ti) SELECT ID, exam_count, share, margin_above_avg FROM with_shares WHERE margin_above_avg > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC
